# DSH Side Chat
English · 简体中文
Independent side conversations in DeepSeek Harness's native right sidebar. Keep each side question i
n its own conversation tab, with its own draft, transcript and child-session controls.
> **v1.0.0-rc.1 is a major rewrite prerelease, not a stable upgrade.** It requires exactly **DSH `0.
2.0-rc.2`**. Desktop cold-start and coexistence with Better Sidebar remain unverified. This version
is distributed through GitHub as an installable tarball, **not published to npm**. Read the migratio
n guide before replacing v0.4.
## Install the prerelease
Download **`lukeknow0-dsh-side-chat-1.0.0-rc.1.tgz`** and **`SHA256SUMS`** from the v1.0.0-rc.1 Rele
ase. Verify the checksum in the download directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Try an isolated disposable profile first. For the DSH Web CLI, in a separate terminal:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then start that isolated Web profile and use its normal authentication. Do not grant a version exemp
tion. The Desktop profile is managed by the Desktop app's plugin manager, not by the Web CLI. Back u
p your profile before opting into this prerelease; do not treat the Web checks as Desktop acceptance
your profile before opting into this prerelease; do not treat the Web checks as Desktop acceptance.
The package remains **`@lukeknow0/dsh-side-chat@1.0.0-rc.1`**. Installing the package name from npm,
or installing the workspace root directly, does **not** install this GitHub-only prerelease.
## What changed
- **Native conversation tabs:** use the sidebar's add/guide entry, “新建侧聊”, to open an independent bl

ank page. Multiple child conversations can be open at once.
- **Deferred child creation:** opening a
n empty page does not create a Session. Its first send creates the child; adding a file also creates

the child needed for an upload receipt, without sending a prompt.
- **Separate drafts and history:*
* each tab addresses only its own child. Reopen saved conversations from the blank page. Closing a t

ab does not cancel, archive or delete its Session.
- **Child controls:** Host catalog-backed model/p
ermission choices, child questions and approval decisions, plus explicit cancellation of generation.
- **Web attachments:** upload, drag-and-drop or paste supported clipboard images; see progress, rem
ove files or retry. File receipts stay child-scoped; images use native image content. Attachment-onl

y messages are supported.
- **No automatic write-back:** side-chat messages are not appended to the
parent. A model selection does not rewrite the existing parent Session, but the Host may save it as
the default for subsequently created unconfigured Sessions.
Interface copy is currently Chinese. Attachment admission is at most 10 files and 20 MB per file; th
e Host may enforce stricter limits. Unsent files remain in memory during tab navigation, **not acros
s browser reloads**. Annotations and answer return are development-only, not accepted runtime featur
es in this prerelease.
## Permissions and retained data
**This rewrite is not an always-read-only child agent.** It uses the Host's child-session model, per
mission presets and approval flow. Review the child's selected permissions before sending a prompt;
the legacy fixed tool allowlist/deny guard is not carried over. Full-access/automatic presets requir
e the Host's risk-acknowledgement path.
Tabs are a UI lifetime, not a data-erasure boundary. Closing a tab does not end its child or erase i
ts persisted history. There is no v0.4-style automatic 30-minute parked expiry. The old metadata mod
el is not automatically imported. See security guidance and migration notes.
## Compatibility and verification
| Component | Prerelease target |

| DeepSeek Harness | Exactly `0.2.0-rc.2` |
| Node.js plugin runtime | `>=22.19.0` |
| Development /

CI | Node `22.20.0` or `24`, pnpm `11.7.0` |
| Client | DSH Web native right-sidebar services |
| D
esktop cold-start / Better Sidebar coexistence | Not verified |
See release verification evidence for the exact checks run. Older phase documents and brand screensh
ots describe earlier builds; they are not proof of this prerelease's runtime compatibility.
## Build from source
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`check` runs Host/Client typechecking, builds the generated Typert faces and lazy-CJS browser bundle
, then runs workspace and plugin tests. `pack:release` creates the versioned archive under `artifact
s/`; `verify:package` checks its identity, exports and loader wiring. Neither command publishes npm
or installs into a DSH profile. Host/Remote declarations are generated before checking Client self-i
mports, so a clean checkout needs no cached build output. Signed managed Node runtimes that cannot l
oad third-party native addons can use `NAPI_RS_FORCE_WASI=1 pnpm run check`; the lockfile/workspace
includes Rolldown's official optional WASI fallback.
